cards.name: hero
cards.title: Social media APIs: **ten portals, or one API**
cards.sub: Each network has its own review, sign-in, uploads and limits. Here’s when to go direct.

right.label: Slow
items: A different media upload per network

steps.title: Pass review
steps.text: Often weeks, sometimes a demo video.

steps.title: Retries
steps.text: Never post twice on a timeout.

steps.title: Platform API
steps.text: One network, or analytics and replies.

steps.title: Unified API
steps.text: Same content, many networks, on a schedule.

bad.label: Risky
items: Libraries that log in with passwords
Breaks on the next app update

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: One network? **Use its API.** Several on a schedule? One API that has already passed every review.
cards.by: And skip unofficial APIs: they’re fast to start and risky to keep.
